candidate_passages.text: TechSearch International identifies HBM4's wider interface and higher data rate as signal-integrity and power-delivery challenges, and links larger HBM counts to package warpage and greater thermal dissipation requiring new cooling and interface materials.
candidate_passages.candidate_claim: An independent 2025 packaging analysis identifies signal integrity, power delivery, warpage, and thermal dissipation as HBM4 integration constraints that peak transfer-rate claims alone do not resolve.
